description: Explanations of non-cash mustering-out benefits gained when leaving a career.

rank_bonuses.5-6: 3 bonus benefit rolls, and DM+1 to all Benefit rolls in this career

rules.gambler_bonus: A Traveller with the Gambler skill gains DM+1 to all rolls on Cash columns.

benefits.Weapon: Select any weapon worth up to Cr3,000 at TL 12 or below. If rolled again, choose: another weapon OR Gun Combat +1 or Melee +1.
benefits.Gun: Select any common or military ranged weapon worth up to Cr3,000 at TL 12 or below. If rolled again, choose: another gun OR Gun Combat +1.
benefits.Blade: Select any blade worth up to Cr1,000 at TL 12 or below. If rolled again, choose: another blade OR Melee (blade) +1.
benefits.Armour: Select any armour worth up to Cr10,000 at TL 12 or below. If rolled again, choose: another set OR trade up to Cr25,000.
benefits.Combat Implant: Select any augmentation (cybernetic implant) worth up to Cr75,000 at TL 12 or below. If rolled again, choose: a different augmentation OR improve your existing one.
benefits.Scientific Equipment: Select any scientific equipment worth up to Cr2,000 at TL 12 or below. If rolled again, choose: more equipment OR Electronics +1 or Science +1.
benefits.Personal Vehicle: A ground car or air/raft worth up to Cr300,000 at TL 10 or below. If rolled again, gain Drive +1 or Flyer +1 instead.
benefits.TAS Membership: Travellers' Aid Society membership — lifetime, non-transferable. Grants access to Class A and B starport lounges and a free High Passage every two months. If rolled again, gain 2 Ship Shares instead.
benefits.Scout Ship: A Scout/Courier on detached duty — still owned by the Scout Service. Expect recall missions. Cannot be sold. If rolled again, re-roll on the same benefits table.
benefits.Free Trader: A Type-A Free Trader. Each benefit roll pays 25% of the mortgage; four rolls clears it. Can substitute a Far Trader. Roll 1D on the Spacecraft Quirks table.
benefits.Lab Ship: A Type-L Lab Ship. Each benefit roll pays 25% of the mortgage; four rolls clears it. Roll 1D on the Old Ships table.
benefits.Ship's Boat: Any small craft worth up to MCr10 at TL 12 or below. If rolled again, gain Pilot (small craft) +1 instead; alternatively, take 1 Ship Share.
benefits.Yacht: A Yacht. Each benefit roll pays 25% of the mortgage; four rolls clears it. Roll 1D on the Old Ships table.
benefits.Ship Share: One ship share worth MCr1 (cannot be redeemed for cash).
benefits.2 Ship Shares: Two ship shares (MCr1 each, not redeemable for cash).
benefits.INT +1: Increase INT by 1 (up to racial maximum).
benefits.EDU +1: Increase EDU by 1 (up to racial maximum).
benefits.SOC +1: Increase SOC by 1. If at or above racial maximum, the excess converts to a Ship Share.
benefits.STR +1: Increase STR by 1 (up to racial maximum).
benefits.DEX +1: Increase DEX by 1 (up to racial maximum).
benefits.END +1: Increase END by 1 (up to racial maximum).
benefits.Characteristic Increases: Increase the listed characteristic, up to racial maximum (15 for most species). Any SOC increase beyond racial max converts to Ship Shares instead.
